same 40 coordinator assertions on adba8a3d main
package strict tsc and focused eslint --no-fix
four browser specs with built main
built ESM default export and source function name

limitations: AudioEngine and VideoEngine remain JS behind explicit temporary declarations; their late internal work is MB-05/06.
Six Windows WebKit capability controls are not successful playback.
Trackless false readiness is corrected; existing-track unsupported codec behavior remains a capability/decoder task.
Synthetic RAF is not decoded frame accuracy; native sampled frames and short clocks are not long-run AV sync.
HLS query source ownership is guarded; full concurrent selection/UI topology remains MB-07.
No npm release or next-major approval is implied.
